tpms.when: 2010 (low tire pressure warning light, no driver reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the tire information placard on the driver's door jamb, before driving or after the car has sat for a few hours.
Switch the engine to ON and drive normally. With the pressures corrected, the low tire pressure light should go out on its own; there is no reset button.
If the light comes back on soon after filling, a tire is probably leaking or flat: stop somewhere safe and check it.
At high altitude the light may stay on at the placard pressure; adding a little air above the placard figure clears it.
tpms.note: If the light flashes instead of staying steady, or does not light for about two seconds at start-up, the system itself needs a dealer check. A message on the information display can also mean a new sensor's ID has not been registered.
